newsitem.title: USA: Global Village names Peterson CFO.
newsitem.headline: Global Village names Peterson CFO.

text.p: Global Village Communication Inc on Tuesday said it has named John Peterson as its chief financial officer, replacing James Walker, who resigned in November to assume another job.

"John has great experience with a number of successful high-tech companies," said Neil Selvin, chief executive officer of Global Village Communication. "His insights into financial and business strategy will be a great asset to us."
Peterson had been chief financial officer and vice president of finance and administration at Calera Recognition Systems, a $15 million optical character recognition company.
